liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Music Never Stopped** (3 reviews): Jerry and Bobby ended it at different times; Jerry then played a strong Might As Well; Bobby forgot the words to it [5][14][16]
- **Eyes of the World** (3 reviews): Eyes emerged from Space and was a nice highlight; Playing Eyes out of Space was a novelty, though the show was otherwise unremarkable to this listener [5][6][11]
- **Might As Well** (2 reviews): Might As Well rocks; Might As Well is called killer [7][9]
- **It's All Over Now** (1 review): All Over Now gets a different treatment from usual [15]
- **Hell in a Bucket** (1 review): One of the slowest Hell in a Buckets, contrasting with the very fast Eyes [13]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The China Cat/Rider jam is a personal all-time favorite [13]
- **Lost Sailor** (1 review): Jerry played ripping lead on Lost Sailor [14]
- **Space** (1 review): Space is eerie and creeping, with crystal chimes and howls, and it dissolves into Eyes [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **Black Peter tease**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd84-04-06.sbd.willy.10159.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 155 min; rated 3.79/5 by 29 [1]. Said about its sound: Bertha has multiple mix problems in this recording; Recording is clean throughout except during Bertha; Brent's chimey keyboard tones are especially prominent in the recording [8][9][13][15]
- **gd1984-04-06.148570.sbd.clugston.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 157 min [2]
- **gd1984-04-06.109232.beyer-senn-daweez.D5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 152 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1984-04-06.nak301.dalessandro-suraci.77310.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 140 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [4]

## Around the show

- Rumor: a tourhead named Peter died hitching to the show; Jerry supposedly played Black Peter in tribute, but Bobby disagreed [6]
- Twirling dancers' silhouettes were visible in the concourse openings of the round hall; heads spilled onto the Strip afterwards [7]
- Jerry and Bobby apparently had musical differences that night [9]
- Unlike the remote Silver Bowl shows, this venue sat in the middle of the city [7]
- This Eyes is among the fastest ever, contrasted with the slowest Eyes at Miami 4/7/94 [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd84-04-06.sbd.willy.10159.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>MC>DAT>CDR [1]. Also: Soundboard transferred to cassette master, then DAT, then CDR via Paul B; seeded to etree by Willy [1]
- **gd1984-04-06.148570.sbd.clugston.flac16**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard Cassettes; Sony D6 (dolby C) > Dat > PCM [2]. Also: Upgrade uses a Beyer M160/Nakamichi 100 front-of-board source for crowd sound and several short patches; The US Blues encore comes entirely from the Paul B./Willy soundboard; Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction [2]
- **gd1984-04-06.109232.beyer-senn-daweez.D5scott.flac16**: taped by DaWeez; transferred by D5scott; source: 2 Beyer M160 & 1 Sennheiser 421 Microphones (13th row-center) > Nak MX100 w/2001 > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes [3]
- **gd1984-04-06.nak301.dalessandro-suraci.77310.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Tony Suraci; Eugene D'alessandro; transferred by Tony Suraci; source: Nakamichi CM300*(with CP1 Card caps)>Sony TCD-5M Location: FOB/Right Center Orch. Sec. 1 Row M/Stand at 6-7 Feet [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead GD Laminate, Las Vegas, NV & Irvine, CA](https://www.dead.net/archives/1984/clippings/gd-laminate-las-vegas-nv-irvine-ca) [18]
- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-04-06 Aladdin Theater, Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-04-06-aladdin-theater-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [19]

Unlike the remote Silver Bowl shows, this venue sat in the middle of the city
Might As Well rocks
This Eyes is among the fastest ever, contrasted with the slowest Eyes at Miami 4/7/94

All Over Now gets a different treatment from usual
Bobby runs his whammy bar through effect units; Phil and Jerry play with tension
